verdict.rationale: Cline's own pricing page says users can 'self-host anytime'. The core agent installs and runs locally (npm CLI, IDE extensions), and the docs support fully local model runtimes such as Ollama and LM Studio, which a community user confirms worked well. However, there is no dedicated self-hosting guide covering hosted components like the hub, Kanban board or Cline provider backend, so the extent of self-hosting is unproven. Missing for 10: dedicated self-hosting/deployment documentation for server-side components (hub, Kanban, provider backend), and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You're never locked into our platform or pricing. Switch providers or self-host anytime.
Run Cline with local models using Ollama, LM Studio or Atomic Chat.
Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): use your own provider credentials (cloud or local runtimes).
